arithmetic: Python integers and fractions.Fraction; sympy for symbolic identities

a_cofactor_lemma_and_triangles.label: exact computation
a_cofactor_lemma_and_triangles.statement: At generic exact points the complete ray set is D_T; every ray cofactor equals the lemma formula and satisfies the Darboux identity; c(e)-c(f) lies in span(l_e,l_f) iff e,f lie in a common triangle {s_u,s_v,r_uv}.

b_one_sided_rigidity.label: exact computation
b_one_sided_rigidity.statement: For every cone spanning tree S at generic exact points (n<=6): the n-subsets of rays that are linearly independent are exactly the cone spanning trees; the compatibility graph on S equals the set of size-2 fundamental paths (computed linearly and checked against graph fundamental paths); whenever it is a spanning tree it is isomorphic to T. For n<=5, the S-conjugated matrix lies in L_{T'} (labelled T' via Pruefer codes) iff every edge of T' is compatible, and then T' is isomorphic to T.

c_sharpness_and_strata.label: exact computation
c_sharpness_and_strata.statement: For every tree n<=6 and every factor of Delta_T, at exact points where exactly that factor vanishes: d_{v->j}=0 gives exactly the coordinates and the other n-2 edge rays (2n-2 rays); d_{u->j}=d_{v->j} gives D_T plus P_uj-P_vj with support {u,v} (2n rays); d_{u->j}=-d_{v->j} gives D_T plus a ray proportional to P_uj - d_{j->v} x_v with support {u,j,v} (2n rays); no pencils. d_{u->v}=d_{v->u}=0 gives a pencil on {u,v}. On 2000 small-integer points per tree (n<=5, entries in -2..2) tree form holds iff Delta_T != 0.

d_family_intersection.label: exact computation
d_family_intersection.statement: P4 = 0-1-2-3 and T' = {02,12,23}: L_T cap L_T' = {A in L_T : b_{0->1} = b_{2->1}}, dim L_T = 10, dim of intersection 9 = 3n-3. For all trees n<=7, every vertex j and ordered pair of distinct neighbours (u,v): T' = T - uj + uv is a tree, dim(L_T cap L_T') = 3n-3 and the intersection is cut out in L_T by b_{u->j} = b_{v->j}.

e_normalised_family_tangent_space.label: exact computation
e_normalised_family_tangent_space.statement: For every tree n<=6, the homogeneous quadratic vector fields on K^n tangent to every hyperplane x_i=0 and x_u-x_v=0 (uv in E) form a space of dimension 2n-1 equal to the LV fields with A in L_T and d_{u->v}=d_{v->u} on every edge.

f_caterpillar_formula.label: exact computation
f_caterpillar_formula.statement: For every caterpillar (core a path v_1..v_m, m>=2) with n<=10, the closed formula q (R(w) = det(L_{P_k}+diag w), with the palindrome correction) equals the decorated-core count of lv_core_count.py, and for n<=9 equals the cone-basis orbit count of verify.py.

g_worked_P3_example.label: exact computation
g_worked_P3_example.statement: Worked P3 example (paper labels 1-2-3, zero-based 0-1-2): symbolic matrix, edge Darboux polynomials and Delta; concrete integer point with 5 rays, 8 cone bases, 2 hypergraph classes.

h_van_der_Kamp_13_parameter_system.label: exploratory
h_van_der_Kamp_13_parameter_system.note: Exploratory: records the complete linear Darboux structure of matrix (34) of arXiv:2411.18264v4 at 5 deterministic integer points; status PASS means the computation completed, not that any expectation holds.

i_kahan_identity.label: exact computation
i_kahan_identity.statement: Symbolically (sympy): for every ray P of the generic P3 system and for the coordinate rays of a general 3x3 matrix, P(B(x,y)) = (P(x)C(y)+P(y)C(x))/2 and P(y)(1-hC(x)/2) - P(x)(1+hC(y)/2) = P(y-x) - h P(B(x,y)) identically, so the Kahan relation y - x = h B(x,y) gives P(x')(1-hC(x)/2) = P(x)(1+hC(x')/2). For general linear P, C and a general 3x3 matrix, P(B(x,y)) - (P(x)C(y)+P(y)C(x))/2 is the polarisation of P(x*Ax) - P(x)C(x).

j_constant_growth_rate.label: exact computation
j_constant_growth_rate.statement: For a generic exact P3 point, the complete rays of x' = x(7 + Ax) equal those of x' = x(Ax) (cofactor shifted by the constant 7), each verified coefficientwise.

k_orthant_bases.label: exact computation
k_orthant_bases.statement: For P4 at a generic positive and a generic mixed-sign exact point, among the 21 cone spanning-tree bases only the all-spokes basis admits row signs D with DB >= 0 and (DB)^{-1} >= 0 (equivalently, only it is monomial).
